description: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 extension trait over jmap-base-client. JmapFileNodeExt adds 6 typed methods: file_node_get, file_node_changes, file_node_set (FileNodeSetRequest with onDestroyRemoveChildren, onExists: FileNodeOnExists enum Replace/Rename, compareCaseInsensitively), file_node_copy (FileNodeCopyRequest with fromAccountId), file_node_query (FileNodeQueryRequest with depth), file_node_query_changes. Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13. Pattern: jmap-chat-client. Blocked by: jmap-filenode-types epic.
title: jmap-filenode-client: JMAP FileNode client methods
